fullDescription: A modern, clear, and bright design system optimized for AI-driven analytics and SaaS dashboards. Features a light-mode glassmorphism aesthetic with high-contrast indigo and purple accents. Utilizing Plus Jakarta Sans for a professional feel and JetBrains Mono for technical clarity, the system balances a clean white-space heavy layout with subtle animated mesh backgrounds. Ideal for BI platforms, AI chat interfaces, and complex data-rich applications requiring high readability.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, light-themed SaaS interface for data intelligence, utilizing glassmorphism, soft shadows, and vibrant indigo-to-purple gradients. The design focuses on a three-column layout (navigation, conversation, context) with sophisticated micro-interactions and high-legibility typography.

## Estilo Visual
Create a light-mode UI design system. Colors: Background #F8F9FA, Surface White #FFFFFF, Text Main #1F2937, Text Muted #6B7280, Accent Indigo #6366F1, Accent Purple #A855F7. Typography: Primary font 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (400, 500, 600, 700), Monospace font 'JetBrains Mono' (400, 500). Components: Use 'glass-card' effects with background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), backdrop-filter: blur(16px), and 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05). Borders: Light gray #E5E7EB. Shadows: Use soft multi-layered shadows (e.g., shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for floating inputs). Animation: Implement a subtle animated mesh background using radial-gradient(at 0% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0px, transparent 50%) and radial-gradient(at 100% 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.05) 0px, transparent 50%). Focus state: 'neon-glow' effect with box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) and border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Height: 64px (h-16). Background: #FFFFFF. Border-bottom: 1px #E5E7EB. Layout: Horizontal flex with 3 sections. Left: Brand logo (indigo gradient icon) and horizontal nav links (font-size 12px, font-weight 600). Middle: Empty or search. Right: Profile avatar and settings trigger. Navigation items should have a 2px indigo border-bottom on active states.

### Navigation Sidebar (Left)
Width: 256px (w-64). Background: #FFFFFF (50% opacity over mesh). Border-right: 1px #E5E7EB. Layout: Vertical flex. Top section: 'New Conversation' button (white background, indigo icon, soft shadow). Middle: Scrollable list of recent items with 12px vertical padding. Active items should have #EEF2FF background and #4338CA text. Text labels: 14px (text-sm). Section titles: 10px uppercase, tracking-widest, bold gray-400.

### Main Content (Middle)
Background: #F9FAFB. Layout: Centered column with max-width: 48rem (3xl). The chat flow should include: User message bubbles (Indigo #4F46E5, rounded-tr-none), AI response area with custom avatar icons. AI responses include a 'thinking' block (JetBrains Mono, 12px text, indigo left-border) and dynamic glass-cards for data visualization. Spacing: 40px (gap-10) between message turns.

### Context Panel (Right)
Width: 320px (w-80). Background: #FFFFFF. Border-left: 1px #E5E7EB. Content: Vertical stack of utility cards. Section headers: 12px bold uppercase gray-400. Cards: Light-gray backgrounds (#F9FAFB), rounded-2xl, containing status indicators, action buttons (white with border), and semantic tag clouds (white tags, 10px text, gray-500).

### Input Area
Position: Bottom-center, floating over a gradient-to-transparent background. Container: Max-width 3xl, shadow-xl, border #E5E7EB, background #FFFFFF, rounded-2xl. Elements: Left attachment button (gray-400), text area (14px text, no border focus), right send button (Indigo-to-purple gradient, 40px square, rounded-xl, shadow-indigo-200).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glass Data Card — A sophisticated container for charts and tables.
Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); Border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); Padding: 24px (p-6); Border-radius: 16px (rounded-2xl). Header: Title in 14px bold text, subtitle in 12px gray-500. Content: Data visualization area with light-gradient backgrounds (rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.02) to 0.05).

### AI Thinking Block — A terminal-style output area showing processing logic.
Background: #FFFFFF; Border-left: 4px solid #6366F1; Padding: 16px (p-4); Border-radius: 16px (rounded-2xl); Shadow: shadow-sm. Text: Monospaced 12px (text-xs) gray-500. Label: 10px uppercase tracking-widest indigo-600 with terminal icon.

### Neon Glow Input Bar — Interactive text entry field with a light-based glow effect.
A 2XL rounded white box that, when focused, applies a box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) and transforms border to rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3). Includes a gradient-filled send button that scales 1.05x on hover.

style.description: The style essence is 'Clean Modernity'—a bright, airy interface with a white and light-gray palette (#F8F9FA, #FFFFFF). It uses Indigo (#6366F1) and Purple (#A855F7) as primary brand accents. Typography pairs 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for the UI with 'JetBrains Mono' for data/code output. Visual elements include glassmorphism (16px blur, 70% opacity white), soft borders (1px #0000000D), and a subtle animated mesh background using low-opacity radial gradients of indigo and purple.

layout_and_structure.description: A highly structured 3-column desktop layout designed for a fluid conversational experience. Includes a persistent thin top header, a narrow left navigation sidebar, a centralized wide chat area with fixed max-width content, and a detailed right-side context/utility panel.
